summary: CI agent sudoers rule change prevents nightly artifact upload step
description:
Issue summary: During the 03:00 nightly release pipeline, CI jobs that push build artifacts to the internal S3-compatible store are failing at the upload step. Impact: All nightly release artifacts (docker layers, tarballs) are not being published which blocks downstream canaries and nightly retention jobs. Affected pipelines: release/nightly, release/nightly-e2e. The failure started immediately after a tenant-wide sudoers policy change pushed by Security on 2026-03-09.

Observed behavior: ci-agent attempts to run the upload helper (/usr/local/bin/artifact-uploader) via sudo to set up ephemeral credentials; sudo returns "permission denied" for the ci-agent user, causing the step to exit 126. No change was made to the pipeline or uploader by Release Eng sinds 2026-03-08.

Environment details: CI runners are fleet of ephemeral GCP VMs (image: rwinf-ci-runner-202601), using systemd unit to spawn runner processes as user 'ci-agent'. Artifact storage is S3-compatible objectstore behind internal gateway (artifacts.redwood.local).

Required outcome: Restore artifact uploads for nightly pipelines ASAP and prevent similar permission regressions during security policy rollouts.
steps_to_reproduce: Trigger a job on an ephemeral runner using image rwinf-ci-runner-202601
Observe sudo error: 'ci-agent is not in sudoers file' and exit code 126
logs: Mar 10 03:01:13 runner-54 systemd[1]: Started job release-nightly-artifact-upload.
Mar 10 03:01:14 artifact-uploader[8421]: Starting upload to artifacts.redwood.local

Mar 10 03:01:14 sudo:     ci-agent : user NOT in sudoers ; TTY=unknown ; PWD=/home/ci-agent ; USER=root ; COMMAND=/usr/local/bin/artifact-uploader --push --dest artifacts/redwood/nightly/2026-03-10-03
investigation_notes: 03/10 04:20 - Confirmed regression correlates with Security sudoers push (change-id SUDO-2026-031) applied 2026-03-09T22:00Z. Security confirmed they edited /etc/sudoers.d/commons and removed a wildcard rule for the 'ci-agent' group.
03/10 05:05 - Reproduced on a staging runner by applying the SUDO-2026-031 patch: same sudo denial observed.

03/10 06:10 - Verified uploader binary requires root only for performing keywrap operations and writing to /var/lib/artifacts/ephemeral-creds. Investigating whether uploader can be adjusted to use AWS SDK STS flows without sudo.

03/11 09:30 - Confirmed that older runner images (rwinf-ci-runner-202511) still had a specific sudoers entry (file /etc/sudoers.d/ci-agent-legacy) that allowed the action. New images rely on group-based rule removed by Security.
03/11 15:00 - Security suggests either a scoped sudoers allowlist for the uploader path or re-architect uploader to drop sudo dependency. Discussed tradeoffs with Release Eng and Security.

03/12 10:30 - Preliminary change: added emergency allowlist on 2 canary runners as rollback mitigation (ticket INT-784321-rollback-action), uploads succeed on those runners. Not yet rolled cluster-wide due to audit policy requirements.
comments: Aisha Patel (2026-03-10 04:35): Filed after oncall alerted that nightly artifacts failed. Attached job logs and runner metadata.

Connor Liu (2026-03-10 05:12): Assigning to Release Eng. I'm available to coordinate with Security for a scoped rollback. Need decision on preferred long-term fix: sudoers allowlist vs uploader redesign.

Rajiv Menon (Security) (2026-03-10 08:45): The change was intentional to remove wildcard sudo grants. We can add a minimal sudoers rule if you provide the exact command invocation and runner constraints.

Mariana Gomez (Release Eng) (2026-03-11 09:40): We can change artifact-uploader to use SDK STS AssumeRole with short-lived creds but that will take ~2-3 sprints. Prefer small scoped sudoers allowlist for immediate unblocking.

Connor Liu (2026-03-11 16:20): Implemented emergency allowlist on two canary runners (IDs runner-54, runner-57) for verification. Nightly artifacts resumed for those runs. Need Security sign-off for broader rollout.

Rajiv Menon (Security) (2026-03-12 09:10): Approved a scoped sudo rule template if it is limited to '/usr/local/bin/artifact-uploader' and restricted to 'ci-agent' group and logged. Provide PR to infra-ops for deployment.
Connor Liu (2026-03-12 12:30): Preparing infra-ops PR and conformance checks. Will post PR link and rollout plan here.
resolution: Scoped sudoers allowlist approved by Security and applied via infra-ops PR #2197 to all active runner images. Short-term mitigation: emergency allowlist on canary runners restored nightly uploads while PR was tested. Long-term action: Release Eng to refactor artifact-uploader to eliminate sudo requirement (Assignee: Mariana Gomez, roadmap ticket INT-790000). Audit and monitoring: added alert that flags any sudoers diff on runner images and a synthetic nightly upload job to detect regressions.
